answer: A quartz escrow clock starves fake identities: any bid above ten units locks a 36-unit bond until its work is confirmed. Each finished job becomes a public juniper record, countersigned by its client; a bid needs six records from three clients in a month. Two raven auditors verify one random record with its client within a day; a forged record, one spent twice, or a silent client burns the bond. 100 fakes need 600 records and risk 3,600 units.
